scripts.dev:apps: concurrently -k -n backend,worker,frontend "npm run dev -w @reachinbox/backend" "npm run dev -w @reachinbox/worker" "npm run dev -w @reachinbox/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:shared: npm run build -w @reachinbox/contracts && npm run build -w @reachinbox/db && npm run build -w @reachinbox/search
scripts.build:apps: npm run build -w @reachinbox/backend && npm run build -w @reachinbox/worker && npm run build -w @reachinbox/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @reachinbox/backend && npm run typecheck -w @reachinbox/worker && npm run typecheck -w @reachinbox/frontend
